title: Purair® FLOW Laminar Flow Cabinets
meta_title: Purair FLOW Laminar Flow Cabinets - Vertical Airflow Hoods
meta_description: Purair FLOW Series benchtop laminar flow cabinets provide vertical laminar airflow with HEPA filtration to protect equipment and contents from particulates.
meta_keywords: laminar flow cabinet, vertical laminar flow, HEPA filtration, clean bench, lab equipment
short_description: Purair® FLOW Series benchtop laminar flow cabinets are compact and ideal for laboratory environments with limited space. The vertical laminar flow hoods use HEPA filtration to protect equipment and other contents of the work zone from particulates.
full_description: Vertical laminar airflow with HEPA/ULPA filtration protects materials inside the cabinet from particulates. High efficiency ebm-papst centrifugal fan. Air cleanliness meets and exceeds ISO Class 5. Energy saving LED lighting. Large front opening provides unrestricted access to the work zone.
seo_content: The Purair FLOW Series of vertical laminar flow cabinets are designed for non-hazardous applications where user protection from biologicals or biohazardous byproducts is not required. These clean benches are ideal for a wide range of laboratory applications including mycology, food microbiology, plant and mammalian cell culture, clinical pharmacies, cleanrooms, semiconductor assembly, pharmaceutical production, aerospace contamination control, medical device assembly, and general research protocols.
